abstract: Human carbonic anhydrases IX and XII are upregulated in many tumors and form a novel target for new generation anticancer drugs. Here we report the synthesis of novel 2-indolinone derivatives with the sulfonamide group as a zinc binding moiety. Enzyme inhibition assays confirmed that the compounds showed selectivity against hCA IX and XII over the widely distributed off-targets hCA I and II. Molecular modelling studies were performed to suggest modes of binding for these compounds.
authors: Karalı N, Akdemir A, Göktaş F, Eraslan Elma P, Angeli A, Kızılırmak M, Supuran CT.
title: Novel sulfonamide-containing 2-indolinones that selectively inhibit tumor-associated alpha carbonic anhydrases.
